LESSON: NAMING SPEAKING

Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.6: Naming SPEAKING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Naming SPEAKING. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Name objects, animals, people and colours in the immediate environment. relevant objects. 18
2. Name safe objects in the immediate environment. identify colours, safe and unsafe
3. Name unsafe objects in the immediate environment.
4. Experience pleasure in naming colours, objects and people in the immediate environment.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Name objects, animals, people and colours in the immediate environment. relevant objects. 18
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to name objects, animals, people and colours in the immediate environment. relevant objects. 18. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Name safe objects in the immediate environment. identify colours, safe and unsafe
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to name safe objects in the immediate environment. identify colours, safe and unsafe. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Name unsafe objects in the immediate environment.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to name unsafe objects in the immediate environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. Experience pleasure in naming colours, objects and people in the immediate environment.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to experience pleasure in naming colours, objects and people in the immediate environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Naming SPEAKING.
2. Explain Naming SPEAKING to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Naming SPEAKING.
4. Show that you can: Name objects, animals, people and colours in the immediate environment. relevant objects. 18
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Naming SPEAKING. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Naming SPEAKING important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Name objects, animals, people and colours in the immediate environment. relevant objects. 18
2. Name safe objects in the immediate environment. identify colours, safe and unsafe
3. Name unsafe objects in the immediate environment.
4. Experience pleasure in naming colours, objects and people in the immediate environment.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
